description: Charts, payment rows and filters: build lightweight CUSTOM SVG/flex charts (PlatformPerformance line chart 979:6234; BarChart 1042:12226 + PaymentMethodChart preset 1030:10140) with NO charting dependency, PaymentRow brand rows (1049:12711), and Filter/FilterGroup/PaymentFilter (1027:9355 / 995:7467 / 1032:10384) reusing the Tag atom + ButtonGroup molecule. Depends on FEAT-001 (card chrome/typography). Independent of FEAT-002/005; shares card-chrome conventions with FEAT-002.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. get_design_context each node id (fileKey y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR) before building; ADAPT to tokens, never paste raw Figma code. NO new dependency — charts are hand-built SVG/flex.

PlatformPerformance — src/components/organisms/platform-performance.tsx (node 979:6234). Card header: Badge (primary-light) + title (paragraph-sm medium text-primary) + 32px navy icon chip. Body: a self-contained responsive SVG line chart from a data:{label,value}[] prop (+ optional yTicks): horizontal gridlines stroke-border, a polyline/path in stroke-primary (or stroke-secondary), x-axis labels (text-body paragraph-xxsm). a11y: wrap the SVG with role="img" + aria-label text summary AND a visually-hidden textual summary. Card: rounded-lg + p-6 + shadow-card + border. Props: title, data, badgeLabel?, icon?.

BarChart — src/components/organisms/bar-chart.tsx (node 1042:12226). Generic vertical bar chart: flex columns, each a rounded-sm filled bar scaled height = value/max (clamped 0..100%), value label above + category label below (text-body xxsm), optional y-axis tick labels. a11y: role="img" + aria-label summary; each bar accessibly named. Props: data:{label,value,color?}[], title?, max?, formatValue?. Card chrome identical to PlatformPerformance.

PaymentMethodChart — src/components/organisms/payment-method-chart.tsx (node 1030:10140). Thin preset wrapping BarChart with brand colors supplied as DATA via props (V.Cash #e60000, O.Cash #ff7900, Mastercard #000, Mezza #007300, Visa #1434cb) — keep brand hexes in this preset/consumer, NOT in globals.css. Props: data (label+value, color defaulted by method) + title?.

PaymentRow — src/components/organisms/payment-row.tsx (node 1049:12711). forwardRef<HTMLLIElement> <li>: leading brand icon chosen by a method prop mapping to VodafoneIcon/OrangeIcon/VisaIcon/MastercardIcon (or an icon override), method label, optional masked detail + amount. Props: method?, icon?, label, detail?, amount?. Logical props.

Filter + FilterGroup — src/components/organisms/filter.tsx. Filter = a single selectable chip wrapping the Tag atom with a `selected` prop (pressed state) — do NOT restyle Tag. FilterGroup = a labelled role="group" + aria-label set of Filter chips with value/onValueChange (single or multi select), keyboard navigable (compose ButtonGroup semantics). Export both.
PaymentFilter — src/components/organisms/payment-filter.tsx (node 1032:10384). A FilterGroup preset for payment methods (brand labels), prop-driven with i18n fallback.
Barrel-export every new symbol (+ *Variants) from src/components/organisms/index.ts.

Add tests (NextIntlClientProvider + en.json): platform-performance.test.tsx (img-role figure with aria-label + each label renders), bar-chart.test.tsx (bar count, labels, max scaling), payment-method-chart.test.tsx (brand presets), payment-row.test.tsx (brand icon by method + label), filter.test.tsx (selecting a chip toggles aria-pressed / fires onValueChange).
Any new i18n fallback strings go into organisms.dashboard in BOTH messages files, in sync.
acceptance_criteria: Charts are custom SVG/flex with NO charting dependency added to package.json; brand colors live in the preset/consumer, not in globals.css.
Charts expose role="img" + aria-label summaries; filters are keyboard-operable with correct aria.
All new organisms barrel-exported; Tag/ButtonGroup reused without restyling.
Colocated tests pass; messages-parity green; `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` succeed.
verification: npm run typegen; npm run typecheck
